title: OCS/GCS qconf host group schema
description: Schema describing the JSON produced and consumed by qconf -fmt json -shgrp / -Mhgrp: a host group definition.

hostlist.description: Member host names, nested host group names and/or matchers, as stored (or empty when NONE). This is the definition and the only member key qconf -Mhgrp reads.

hosts.description: Derived from hostlist: the literal host names. Written by qconf -fmt json -shgrp only when the group carries a matcher; ignored on input.

hostgroups.description: Derived from hostlist: the references to other host groups. Written by qconf -fmt json -shgrp only when the group carries a matcher; ignored on input.

matchers.description: Derived from hostlist: the matchers, which describe a set of hosts instead of naming one. Written by qconf -fmt json -shgrp only when the group carries one; ignored on input.
